summary: AstraZeneca filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign issuer) announcing that the CHMP of the EMA recommended approval of Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan), a TROP2-directed ADC co-developed with Daiichi Sankyo, for 1st-line treatment of metastatic triple-negative breast cancer in the EU. The recommendation is based on the TROPION-Breast02 Phase III trial showing a 5.0-month median OS improvement vs. chemotherapy. No financial terms, acquisition, or special-situation transaction is involved. This is a routine regulatory update, equivalent to a press release on drug approval progress.
